data.gender_notes: Tome is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘tomus’, meaning ‘book’ or ‘scroll’. This name was given to individuals who were scribes or scholars in the Roman Empire. In Christianity, it is also used as a name for the early Christian writings, such as the New Testament. The name Tome carries the meaning “Recording, book” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tome usually hope their child will grow to embody recording, book and live with faith, good character and purpose.
